Fonts used to draw subtitles in Sinhala and Tamil
=================================================

These fonts are included unchanged so that subtitles look the same on every
device, whether or not it has Sinhala or Tamil fonts of its own.

  NotoSansSinhala-Regular.ttf, NotoSansSinhala-Bold.ttf
      Noto Sans Sinhala v3.000
      Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/sinhala)

  NotoSansTamil-Regular.ttf
      Noto Sans Tamil v2.004
      Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/tamil)

Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 - see OFL.txt.
